adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is executed unconditionally after the `if/else` that may `render 'loading'`. Since `render` doesn’t automatically halt execution here (no `return`), the loading response will also get the same caching headers as the normal topic-view response. Given `loading.html.erb` triggers `document.location.reload()` after 30s, caching the loading page for up to 1 minute can plausibly cause clients/intermediaries to keep serving the cached loading page even after the topic has been created, delaying display of the discussion.
